usageNotes: Use this to define an HA placement rule that controls whether a set of HA-managed resources must share the same node (positive affinity) or must be kept on separate nodes (negative affinity). Requires the `Sys.Console` privilege at the root path — typically reserved for cluster administrators. Returns null on success; verify the rule was created with the corresponding GET /cluster/ha/rules endpoint.

examples.summary: Keep two VMs on the same node (positive node-affinity, strict)

params.comment: Keep web and DB VMs colocated for low-latency access

tips: The `rule` identifier must be a valid pve-configid (alphanumeric, hyphens allowed, no spaces).
For `resource-affinity` type, the `nodes` param is ignored — only `resources` and `affinity` apply.
Setting `strict: true` means HA will refuse to migrate if the rule cannot be satisfied; use with caution in small clusters.
A disabled rule (`disable: true`) is stored but has no effect on HA scheduling — useful for temporarily suspending a rule without deleting it.
Nodes in the `nodes` list can include optional priority weights (e.g., `pve-node1:10`); higher priority nodes are preferred targets.
